questions: what are the features of sitepulse
entries.reply: SitePulse includes a 3D BIM model viewer, geospatial digital twin, model explorer, model data validation, construction status tracking, crane position monitoring, delivery and vehicle tracking, a project dashboard, and progress history playback.
BIM stands for Building Information Modelling. SitePulse lets you view your 3D BIM model and explore its data alongside what is actually happening on site.
The geospatial digital twin in SitePulse is a live digital copy of your site, placed on the map, so you can see the project in its real-world context.
Yes. SitePulse includes crane position monitoring, so you can see where your cranes are on site.
SitePulse offers delivery and vehicle tracking, helping you see what is arriving on site and where vehicles are.
With progress history playback, you can replay how the project has progressed over time, and construction status tracking shows where each part stands today.

OfficePulse is a smart workforce management solution. It gives real-time visibility of site personnel, task assignments and workforce movements, so you can coordinate better and use your resources wisely.

OfficePulse gives you centralised workforce tracking, including where personnel are, what tasks they are on, and how work is progressing.
